source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Once per battle round for your army, during your own Shooting phase, you may pick one visible enemy unit no more than 12" away from any WAR DOG unit of yours. The chosen unit's detection range is increased by 6". This lasts for the rest of that phase. This detachment carries the WAR DOGS tag, so it cannot be combined with any other WAR DOGS detachment.

fields.durationBasis: core rule 01.02.02 Persisting Rules Effects (core/core_rules.json /sections/0/containers/2/components/2): no stated duration, so it lasts only for the phase in which it was applied
